newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,586 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,586 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 3,586 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 116 wheat, 1,973 corn, 1,342 soybean, 87 soymeal, 64 soyoil, 2 oats and 2 rough rice futures contracts traded along with 36 corn put and 10 soybean call options.

The overnight trend for corn was down 1-3/4 to 2-3/4 cents per bushel, soybeans down 4-1/2 to 5 cents, wheat down one cent, soymeal down $1.00 to $1.20 per ton, soyoil down 0.06 to 0.12 cent per lb, oats unchanged and rough rice up 3 cents per cwt.
